explanation: Formalizes "the first zero is n = 65536" as a(2^16) = 0 together with a(n) ≠ 0 for 1 ≤ n < 2^16. The definition of a (least m > 0 with n·2^m + 1 prime, else 0) matches A078680. This conjunction is exactly "first zero is 65536". The OEIS parenthetical claims equivalence with "2^(2^k)+1 composite for k > 4", but that only covers the first conjunct. The second conjunct also requires the unresolved Sierpiński candidates below 65536 (21181, 22699, 24737, 55459) to have a prime n·2^m + 1. So the formalization is the more accurate reading. The statement is faithful and tagged open.
